candidates.change_summary: Replace the return value selector with a different bytes4 value, e.g. bytes4(0xDEADBEEF), to change the observable return value.
Delete the assignment of state variable baseToken (line 1824) so it retains its zero default value after initialization.
Replace the assignment `nft = _nft;` with `nft = address(0);` so the NFT address is set to zero.
Replace the assignment `nft = _nft;` with `nft = _baseToken;` so the NFT state variable is set to the base token address.
Delete the statement `nft = _nft;` so the NFT address remains its default zero value.
Skip assignment of changeFee so it remains its default zero value.
Assign _changeFee plus 1 to changeFee so the stored fee differs from the parameter.
Replace changeFee assignment with a constant non-zero value so the stored fee is always 1 regardless of the parameter.
Removed the require statement that checks _feeRate <= 5000, allowing _feeRate to be set to any value.
Changed the require condition from _feeRate > 5_000 to _feeRate > 0, so only zero fee rate is accepted.
Replaced the feeRate assignment with feeRate = 0, so the fee rate is always set to zero regardless of input.
Moved the feeRate assignment before the feeRate validation check, so _feeRate is stored before the revert, persisting an invalid value if reentered.
Delete the line 'initialized = true;' so the contract remains uninitialized after the call.
Replace 'initialized = true;' with 'initialized = false;' so the flag is set but incorrectly.
Delete the require-style check 'if (initialized) revert AlreadyInitialized();' so initialize can be called multiple times, resetting initialized to true each time.
